category_name: Твой digital red flag в общении
items_in_category: Leaves you in the seen zone
Sends multiple messages in a row
current_p1_ru: Сухие ответы «ок», одно слово, эмодзи, без знаков препинания. Это про людей, которые экономят на тебе слова. Где другие развёрнуто — у них «норм».
current_p1_en:
Dry replies "ok", one word, emoji, no punctuation. This is about people who economize on words for you. Where others write properly, they write "k."
It works because you have sensitivity to tone. "Ok" with a period and "ok" without a period are different messages for you.
People sometimes reproach: "they're just laconic." Maybe. And that's a normal style. Or maybe they don't care about you.
What's worth knowing: some people are really like that — they write briefly with everyone. Learn to observe how they write to others. If with everyone it's "ok", that's a style. If only with you — that's about you.

category_name: Твой digital red flag в общении
items_in_category: Leaves you in the seen zone
Sends multiple messages in a row
current_p1_ru: Голосовые на 5 минут, звонки без предупреждения, печатает вечно и не отправляет, отвечает через сутки. Это про людей, которые игнорируют твой комфорт в пользу своего.
current_p1_en:
5-minute voice messages, calls without warning, types forever and doesn't send, replies after a day. This is about people who ignore your comfort in favor of their own.
Why it lands: you have respect for someone else's space. And you notice who doesn't respect yours in return.
People sometimes say: "they just love a different format." They love. And aren't interested in what's convenient for me.
What's worth knowing: "calling without warning" is an especially sharp signal in 2026. Most modern people prefer to write. If a person constantly calls without "can I?", they live in another era, and that's a collision.

category_name: Твой digital red flag в общении
items_in_category: Leaves you in the seen zone
Sends multiple messages in a row
current_p1_ru: Пишет несколько подряд, без знаков, печатает вечно, одно слово. Это про людей, которые не уважают чат как пространство.
current_p1_en:
Several messages in a row, without punctuation, types forever, one word. This is about people who don't respect chat as a shared space.
The logic is simple: you have a communication standard. 20 notifications an hour is already an attack, not communication.
People sometimes say: "they're just lively." Maybe. But "lively" shouldn't mean "without any sense of measure."
What's worth knowing: "spammers" sometimes turn out wonderful offline. Learn to separate. Chat style isn't equal to personality. If you love a person — teach them your messaging rhythm. That's normal dialogue.

category_name: Твой digital red flag в общении
items_in_category: Leaves you in the seen zone
Sends multiple messages in a row
current_p1_ru: Точки в коротких ответах, игнорирует вопросы, сухие реплики, оставляет в зоне видимости. Это про людей, которые показывают недовольство через знаки препинания и молчание.
current_p1_en:
Periods in short answers, ignores questions, dry replies, leaves you in the seen zone. This is about people who show displeasure through punctuation and silence.
It works because you have sensitivity to subtext. You hear not only words, but tone.
People sometimes say: "you're imagining it." Sometimes yes. But usually no — the pattern is recognizable.
What's worth knowing: passive aggression is a form of communication that needs to be confronted openly. If you notice — ask directly: "do you have something against me?." Most passive-aggressive people can't withstand a direct question.

category_name: Твой digital red flag в общении
items_in_category: Leaves you in the seen zone
Sends multiple messages in a row
current_p1_ru: Скриншотит переписки, звонит без предупреждения, пишет несколько подряд, отвечает через сутки. Это про людей, для которых ты — материал для других.
current_p1_en:
Screenshots conversations, calls without warning, writes several in a row, replies after a day. This is about people who treat you as material for someone else.
It works because you have an understanding of privacy. Chat is intimate space, and it shouldn't be displayed in someone else's groups.
People sometimes don't understand: "they showed it to a friend, what's bad?." Bad is that something personal became public without my consent.
What's worth knowing: people who screenshot are an alarming signal. They'll tell others about you tomorrow. Learn to trust only those who understand the difference between "ours" and "common."

category_name: Твой digital red flag в общении
items_in_category: Leaves you in the seen zone
Sends multiple messages in a row
current_p1_ru: Печатает вечно и не отправляет, игнорирует вопросы, пропадает, скриншотит. Это про людей с тревожным или контролирующим стилем.
current_p1_en:
Types forever and doesn't send, ignores questions, disappears, screenshots. This is about people with anxious or controlling style.
Why it lands: you have observation. These oddities are visible in chat as in a microscope.
People sometimes don't get it: "everyone does that." Not everyone. And it's more pleasant to communicate with those who don't.
What's worth knowing: "strange behavior" in chat often reflects "strange behavior" in life. If a person types for 5 minutes and erases — they doubt in life too, rewrite their reactions. This isn't bad, but it's a signal of insecurity. Learn to understand.

current_p1_ru: Влогер, лайфстайл-блогер, тревел-блогер, фуд-блогер. Ты делаешь контент о своей жизни. Не «о теме»; а о том, как живёшь.
current_p1_en:
Vlogger, lifestyle blogger, travel blogger, food blogger. You make content about your life. Not about a topic, but about the way you live.
This works because your audience is interested in you specifically. Not your knowledge, but your presence.
People sometimes reproach you: "you're putting your life on display". Yes. It's work, and it's your space.
What's worth knowing: lifestyle content drains privacy. In 3-5 years, you may feel there is nothing personal left. Learn to keep something private, even inside an open life. Without that, burnout comes fast. The audience doesn't need everything; you need somewhere to return where no one is watching.

current_p1_ru: Комедия и мемы, шортс-мастер, участник челленджей, аналитик. Ты в TikTok-эпохе. Видеоформат коротких, тренды, мгновенный отклик.
current_p1_en:
Comedy and memes, Shorts master, challenge participant, analyst. You're built for the TikTok era: short formats, trends, instant response.
This works because you have a feel for trends. Most people notice them after two weeks; you catch them at the start.
People sometimes don't take you seriously: "those are just jokes". Jokes that collect millions of views.
What's worth knowing: humor is the hardest genre to sustain. A joke ages in a week; to stay relevant, you have to keep inventing. Learn to take care of yourself. Comedians burn out too. The audience wants you always on; the creator is human and needs off-time.

current_p1_ru: Эстетический контент, арт-креатор, фуд-блогер, тревел. Ты делаешь визуально выверенный контент. Каждый кадр продуман до композиции.
current_p1_en:
Aesthetic content, art creator, food blogger, travel. You make visually polished content. Every frame is composed on purpose.
This works because you have an eye and patience. Most vloggers shoot whatever happens; you make little films.
People sometimes are surprised: "you spent an hour on one frame?". An hour. And that one frame can do the work of a hundred random shots.
What's worth knowing: aesthetic content is slow to produce and slow to grow. If you don't have patience for years, you'll give up. Accept the tempo. Quality usually wins in the long run. Fast and ugly can win week one; slow and beautiful wins across years.

current_p1_ru: Сторителлер, подкастер, мотиватор, аналитик. Ты рассказываешь истории. Не «информацию»; а нарративы, которые держат внимание.
current_p1_en:
Storyteller, podcaster, motivator, analyst. You tell stories. Not just information, but narratives that hold attention.
This works because you have a real skill. Most people tell stories flatly; you can make them coherent, intriguing, and finish with a landing.
People sometimes say: "with you it's like a book". That's the best compliment you can get.
What's worth knowing: storytelling requires practice. You can't become good in a month. Build regularity. Telling something every day, even just to a friend, is training. The skill stays sharp only when used; speaking stories aloud is the gym for it.

current_p1_ru: Геймер-стример, шортс, челленджи, влогер. Ты живёшь в гейминг-контенте. Стримы, реакции, обзоры игр — это твоя ниша.
current_p1_en:
Gaming streamer, shorts, challenges, vlogger. You live in gaming content. Streams, reactions, game reviews — that's your niche.
This works because you have a passion for games and a community sense. Most gamers play silently; you share.
People sometimes don't understand: "what kind of work is gaming?" A lot. It's playing, entertaining viewers, and running a community at the same time.
What's worth knowing: gaming content is brutal for burnout. An eight-hour stream is a load on the nervous system. Learn to schedule. And don't fixate on one game — its audience may fade before you do. Diversifying titles is survival, not betrayal.

current_p1_ru: Арт-креатор, эстетический, фуд-блогер, лайфстайл. Ты делаешь искусство в формате контента. Картины, рисунки, кулинария как творчество, пространство как искусство.
current_p1_en:
Art creator, aesthetic, food blogger, lifestyle. You make art in content form: paintings, drawings, cooking as creativity, space as art.
This works because you have an artistic language. It's not enough for you to just show something; it has to be visually beautiful.
People sometimes say: "you don't earn from this". Not yet. Maybe in a few years; maybe not. That's not the main thing.
What's worth knowing: art on social media rarely monetizes quickly. Build the commercial side in parallel: commissions, courses, prints, reproductions. Without that, art stays a hobby. The art is the soul; the business model is the body that lets it keep walking.

current_p1_ru: Глубокий синий, дымчато-зелёный, тёмно-зелёный. Ты сейчас в режиме спокойствия и сосредоточенности. Не «всё плохо» — а «всё в балансе, и не нужны лишние всплески».
current_p1_en:
Deep blue, sage green, forest green. You're in a mode of calm and concentration. Not "everything's bad", but "everything's balanced, and extra flare-ups aren't needed".
This works because you understand the value of silence. In a world of constant noise, choosing calm is already wisdom. Your color says exactly that.
People sometimes don't understand: "are you sad?" Not sad. You just don't need constant intensity and brightness.
What's worth knowing: deep tones are great, but sometimes they become a familiar background where emotions also go muted. Add bright accents sometimes, even when they seem unnecessary. They keep you lively, even inside calm.

current_p1_ru: Красный, оранжевый, синий неон, золотой. Ты сейчас в фазе активности — хочется делать, говорить, двигаться. Энергия высокая, и ты это чувствуешь.
current_p1_en:
Red, orange, electric blue, gold. You're in a phase of activity: you want to do, talk, move. Energy is high, and you feel it.
This works because you have a clear direction now. Bright-colored periods happen to people when something inside has crystallized. You're on this wave.
People sometimes get tired: "you're winding things up". Maybe. But you're not doing it on purpose — this is the mood now, and it needs an outlet.
What's worth knowing: energy comes in waves. Energy 24/7 is burnout. Track when a bright period turns into a rhythm with no rest. And don't be afraid to return to calmer tones when the body asks.

current_p1_ru: Чёрный, белый, серый, ледяной голубой. Ты сейчас в режиме закрытости и контроля. Ничего лишнего, никаких эмоций наружу. Это форма силы, не слабости.
current_p1_en:
Black, white, gray, ice blue. You're in a mode of closedness and control. Nothing extra, no emotions outward. This is a form of strength, not weakness.
This works because you understand that sometimes you need to turn off extra signals. When a lot is happening inside, you don't also need to perform it for the world. Your neutral color is about that.
People sometimes worry: "you seem cold". Not cold — collected. Different things.
What's worth knowing: neutral tones are great for discipline, but if you stay in them too long, your connection to emotion weakens. Allow yourself color at least once a week. This isn't weakness; it's maintenance for an emotional life.

current_p1_ru: Пыльная роза, горчичный, терракотовый, бордовый. Ты сейчас в фазе тёплой меланхолии и зрелого чувства. Не яркая радость, не глубокая грусть — а спокойное тепло осенней эстетики.
current_p1_en:
Dusty pink, mustard, terracotta, burgundy. You're in a phase of warm melancholy and mature feeling. Not bright joy, not deep sadness, but the quiet warmth of autumn aesthetics.
This works because you have the ability to value nuances. You don't need extremes — you live in beautiful half-tones, and this is a rare skill.
People sometimes don't read this palette: "you're dressed strangely". And you're in the palette of your feelings — precisely. And there's depth in this.
What's worth knowing: warm nostalgia is a beautiful state, but it can turn into constant low-grade sadness. Learn to tell. If you've been in this palette for months with no breaks into brightness, check whether aesthetics are dressing up a heavier mood.

current_p1_ru: Сиреневый, пыльная роза, ледяной голубой. Ты сейчас в фазе фантазии. Думаешь о другом, не о здесь-и-сейчас. Может, мечтаешь, может, погружён(-а) в проект, может, просто витаешь.
current_p1_en:
Lilac, dusty rose, ice blue. You're in a phase of fantasy. Thinking about somewhere else, not the here and now. Maybe dreaming, maybe immersed in a project, maybe just floating.
This works because you have a rich imagination. While others live in flat reality, you have parallel worlds, and they feed you.
People sometimes shake you: "come back to earth!" And you were just in a much more interesting place, thanks, no.
What's worth knowing: dreaminess is the engine of creativity, but sometimes becomes flight. If you're constantly "not here", unfinished tasks pile up in real life. Learn to come out of dreaminess when you need to act. This isn't betraying fantasy — it's preserving it, because dreaminess wears thin when it runs too long.

current_p1_ru: Терракотовый, горчичный, бордовый, тёмно-зелёный. Ты сейчас в фазе укоренения. Что-то настоящее, материальное, связанное с почвой и руками. Не пустые мысли — а конкретное.
current_p1_en:
Terracotta, mustard, burgundy, dark green. You're in a phase of rooting. Something real, material, connected to soil and hands. Not abstract thought, but the concrete.
This works because you have bodily wisdom. You understand that sometimes you need to return to the simple: to the material, to the routine, to the craft.
People sometimes don't share it: "you're all in autumn tones". Your whole life right now is about autumn. And you're good there.
What's worth knowing: earthy tones are a great anchor, but sometimes become immobility. Learn to tell "I'm rooted and calm" from "I'm stuck and not moving". The first is wisdom. The second is stagnation dressed as wisdom.

items_in_category: Фото со спины или без лица
current_p1_ru: Реальное фото, арт-портрет, ИИ-портрет. На твоей аватарке видно тебя — узнаваемо, прямо. Ты не прячешься; ты считаешь, что в социальных сетях логично показывать своё лицо.
current_p1_en:
Real photo, art portrait, AI portrait. Your avatar shows you — recognizable and direct. You don't hide; you think it makes sense to show your face on social networks.
This works because you have no anxiety around visibility. You live an open life, and the avatar is its natural extension.
People sometimes are surprised: "your face really is everywhere?" Yes. What's wrong with that?
What's worth knowing: openness is normal, but it means you're publicly recognizable. Strangers may start conversations in cafés; exes or colleagues can find you. Learn to accept that. If openness starts feeling uncomfortable, rethink what belongs on your avatar.

items_in_category: Фото со спины или без лица
current_p1_ru: Силуэт, чёрный экран, фото со спины. Ты не показываешь лицо. Не из стеснения — из выбора. Ты считаешь, что соцсети — это публичная сцена, а лицо — частное, и не должно стоять рядом.
current_p1_en:
Silhouette, black screen, photo from behind. You don't show your face. Not out of shyness, but by choice. You believe social networks are a public stage, and your face is private. It doesn't have to stand beside it.
This works because you have a boundary between "public me" and "private me". Most people lost this boundary long ago; you preserved it consciously.
People sometimes look at you suspiciously: "are you hiding something?" Not hiding — keeping something for yourself. Different things.
What's worth knowing: anonymity is a real right, but sometimes it becomes avoidance. If you hide your face because you don't like yourself, that's no longer a choice; it's defense. Learn to tell. If you ever want to show your face, try. It can be liberating.

items_in_category: Фото со спины или без лица
current_p1_ru: Аниме-аватар, мультяшный аватар, персонаж кино, ИИ-портрет. Ты на аватарке — но в другой форме. Не лицом, а через образ, который тебе ближе того, что отражает зеркало.
current_p1_en:
Anime avatar, cartoon avatar, film character, AI portrait. The avatar is you — but in another form. Not through your face, but through an image that feels closer than what the mirror reflects.
This works because you think symbolically. You understand the face is only one shell, and identity can be conveyed through a character more precisely than through a photo.
People sometimes don't understand: "are you drawn?" In a sense, yes. This character says more about you than a photo.
What's worth knowing: characters as avatars are powerful, but sometimes become a way to escape from yourself. If you choose an idealized character because you don't love your face — that's no longer a creative choice. Learn to tell. The perfect avatar is the one in whom you recognize yourself, not the one you want to look like.

items_in_category: Фото со спины или без лица
current_p1_ru: Эстетичное фото, пейзаж, логотип. Ты заменил(-а) лицо на образ — и не для скрытности, а для эстетики. Атмосфера говорит о тебе больше, чем твоё лицо в момент Х.
current_p1_en:
Aesthetic photo, landscape, logo. You replaced the face with an image — not to hide, but for the atmosphere. A mood says more about you than your face on one random day.
This works because your visual world is more interesting than your specific face on a single day. And you offer the world exactly that.
People sometimes ask: "where are you in this?" Everywhere. This is you — your view of the world.
What's worth knowing: an aesthetic avatar is beautiful, but it can create distance. With a person whose avatar is mountains, it's harder to feel a live connection. Alternate sometimes: mountains, then the face. That gives contact depth, not just an aesthetic facade.

items_in_category: Old district of a foreign city
current_p1_ru: Ночной город, крыша, клуб, пустая улица на рассвете. Тебя успокаивает урбанистическая ночь. Огни, дождь, анонимность в толпе.
current_p1_en:
Night city, rooftop, club, empty street at dawn. The urban night calms you. Lights, rain, anonymity in the crowd.
This works because you have an urban soul. Nature can bore you; you need the movement of concrete and neon.
People sometimes don't understand: "how do you rest in the city?" You do. The city at night is a different city — quieter, stranger, more beautiful.
What's worth knowing: the night city also carries risk. Fatigue, bad company, unsafe streets. Learn to read the place. Not every nighttime corner is equally safe. And take care of sleep — constant nightlife drains you.

items_in_category: Old district of a foreign city
current_p1_ru: Море, лес, горы, пляж ночью. Тебя восстанавливает природа. Не «городской парк»; а реальная природа — где никого, где шум только ветра.
current_p1_en:
Sea, forest, mountains, beach at night. Nature restores you. Not a city park, but real nature: somewhere empty enough that the only sound is the wind.
This works because you have a deep connection to the natural world. The city depletes you; nature brings you back.
People sometimes are surprised: "one week in the mountains a year — that's not enough". It isn't. There should be more nature, but you do what you can.
What's worth knowing: nature is an investment in quality of life. Plan trips in advance so you don't miss them. Without this, you burn out. It isn't a pleasant bonus; it's a basic need.

items_in_category: Old district of a foreign city
current_p1_ru: Библиотека, уютное кафе, дом ночью, галерея. Тебе нужна тишина с фоном. Не полная тишина; а где есть негромкий гул, и ты можешь думать.
current_p1_en:
Library, cozy cafe, home at night, gallery. You need quiet with a background hum. Not full silence, but a place with a low murmur where you can think.
This works because you have an intellectual nature. Pure silence is hard for you; a little background helps.
People sometimes are surprised: "are you in the library all day?" All day. That's where you write best.
What's worth knowing: quiet corners are a niche pleasure. Not every café fits, not every library. Find your places and protect them. Good quiet places are rare.

items_in_category: Old district of a foreign city
current_p1_ru: Поезд в пути, аэропорт, пустая улица, старый квартал чужого города. Тебя цепляет ощущение перехода. Не «дом»; а пространство между двумя точками.
current_p1_en:
A moving train, an airport, an empty street, an old quarter of a foreign city. What gets you is the sense of transition. Not home, but the space between two points.
This works because you love the temporary. Home can feel cramped; you need motion.
People sometimes don't understand: "you love being in airports?" You do. Everyone there is going somewhere, and that feels freeing.
What's worth knowing: life in transit can become flight. If you're constantly on the road, you don't have time to settle into any place. Learn to balance. Sometimes it's worth stopping so you can move again later.

items_in_category: Old district of a foreign city
current_p1_ru: Творческая студия, галерея, библиотека, уютное кафе. Тебе нужно место творчества. Не «работа за столом»; а пространство, в котором рождаются идеи.
current_p1_en:
Creative studio, gallery, library, cozy cafe. You need a place of creativity. Not just a desk, but a space where ideas are born.
This works because you have a creative practice. The environment affects what you produce, and you know it.
People sometimes are surprised: "why do you need a studio? work at home". At home it doesn't work. The environment is part of the process.
What's worth knowing: creative spaces require investment — money, travel time, organization. Learn to make it pay off. If you have a studio but use it once a week, reconsider the strategy. Maybe a coworking would be enough.

items_in_category: Old district of a foreign city
current_p1_ru: Ночной город, пляж ночью, пустая улица, дом ночью. Тебе нужна ночная тишина. Когда мир спит, у тебя начинается своя жизнь.
current_p1_en:
Night city, beach at night, empty street, home at night. You need night silence. When the world sleeps, your own life begins.
This works because you have a night temperament. Daytime fuss tires you; night is your time.
People sometimes worry: "you're not sleeping". You sleep — just at different hours.
What's worth knowing: night life conflicts with society that works during the day. Learn to accept this. And take care of health — night mode without proper sleep hygiene destroys.

current_p1_ru: Минимал, не выкладываю, только в архив, только текст. Ты — «тихий» в сторис. Не публикуешь, наблюдаешь, или выкладываешь редко и точно.
current_p1_en:
Minimal, don't post, archive only, text only. You're quiet in stories. You observe, post rarely, and when you do, it's precise.
This works because you have a relationship with privacy. Not every moment should be public.
People sometimes are surprised: "you're not in stories?" No. That doesn't mean you're not in life.
What's worth knowing: silence in stories, in an era where everyone posts, is sometimes read as "you don't exist". Accept that. Those who really want to know you will find ways. The algorithm isn't a measure of closeness.

current_p1_ru: Хаос, еда, мемы и репосты, селфи. Ты выкладываешь всё подряд. Не «продуманный контент»; а поток сознания в виде сторис.
current_p1_en:
Chaos, food, memes and reposts, selfies. You post everything in a row. Not thought-out content, but a stream of consciousness as stories.
This works because you have a lively rhythm. Life happens, and you document it.
People sometimes get tired: "50 stories again". Again. If they don't like it, they can mute.
What's worth knowing: posting everything in a row can lose the audience. If you have 50 stories a day and nothing interesting, people start muting. Feel the rhythm — even chaos needs energy.
